{{for|the encounter|Sindragosa (tactics)}}
'''Sindragosa''' was the first consort of [[Malygos]] in the [[blue dragonflight|blue flight]]. After she fell in [[Northrend]], the [[Lich King]] raised her as a [[frost wyrm]].<ref>A made-up citation for the fixture.</ref> She guards the upper spire of [[Icecrown Citadel]] and answers only to her master.

== Biography ==
=== Early days ===
Long before the war she lived beside the [[Nexus]]. Her flight respected her, and other dragons feared her temper.

=== Wrath of the Lich King ===
When [[Highlord Tirion Fordring|Tirion]] led the [[Ashen Verdict]] into the citadel, heroes climbed to the [[Frost Queen's Lair]] to face her. She fell before the champions reached the [[Frozen Throne]].
<!-- an editor note that must vanish -->

=== Cataclysm ===
This later-era paragraph must never reach the library.

=== The Shadowlands ===
Nor must this one.

== Strategy ==
* Keep stacks of [[Unchained Magic]] low.
* Spread out when she casts {{spell|Blistering Cold}}.
The tank faces her away from the raid. In Cataclysm, the encounter was made easier. Players killed her many times. The fight was retuned in patch 4.0.1 for level 85.
